items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: to you, Krista Vikstrom, I say keep that banjo man ringing out loud and clear

ctx.x: I'm tired of walking dusty highways, tired of having some old boxcores for my home. Oh yes, yes. I said I'm tired of walking dusty highways, tired of having some old boxcores for my home. Yes, I'm tired of being without someone to love. I'm tired of being so blue and all alone. That's why I'm waiting in the darkness to let Southbound afraid the rattler comes along.
